correctness.rationale: Trace inverse on connected Laplacians is strictly convex in all individual edge conductances because edge-to-Laplacian mapping is injective on a simple graph; unique global optimizer inherits automorphism orbits. Eigenvalues for symmetric conductances a,b are 0, a+rb (multiplicity s(r-1)), a (s-1), and (sr+1)a (1). Reduce budget to (E-F)u+Fv=B with u=a, v=a+rb and objective C/u+A/v. The critical price Q/P=2(sr+1)/(sr) follows from boundary directional derivative, with strict uniqueness even at equality; interior follows Cauchy–Schwarz with z>1. Independent direct weighted Laplacian numerical eigenvalue sums matched closed formula in 12 graph/price cases to about 1e-13; these finite samples corroborate the algebra and cannot certify universal optimality.
